data_fields.name: runDrainPerSec

data_fields.name: maxStamina
data_fields.donor_constant: InitStamina per class (data not in repo)

best_idea: A single stamina pool that drains per second only while sprinting and refills otherwise, with sprint dropping to walk at zero, plus an explicit lock that clears only at a refill ratio.
decision_why: The drain and refill shape and the zero-to-walk fall-back transfer to a melee economy; the donor has no re-entry threshold and hides the rate behind a fixed divisor, so both change; the donor's stat-modifier stack is unwired and is not adopted.
acceptance: The player holds sprint and watches the stamina bar empty; sprint stops and does not restart until the bar refills past the relock ratio; a server test asserts sprint is refused while locked and that the refill threshold is respected.
